title: A fractional CMO on why brand purpose keeps failing — 'they need the governance spine to survive and thrive'
summary: Prasad works as a fractional CMO. He walks the book's cases, from Anthropic's trust to Costco's governance fortress, and argues that one-off purposeful gestures read as stray actions because the organisation is not built to choose the mission when it costs money.
blockquote: Because, mostly, the organisation itself isn’t built to make mission-aligned choices when they hurt the numbers in the short-term. So if brands are serious about their purpose and ethos, they need the governance spine to survive and thrive.
